description: SWEPOS Nätverks-DGNSS-tjänst is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by lantmateriet.se. SWEPOS (Satellite Positioning Support System in Sweden) Network DGNSS service offers navigation support and positioning with half a meter accuracy in real time. The term DGNSS usually refers to real-time relative code measurement at a frequency, i.e. the position of the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receiver is determined relative to a known point. Coverage: Sweden. The portal shows the English title as "SWEPOS Network DGNSS Service" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in OTHER. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://resources.geodata.se/codelist/metadata/anvandningsrestriktioner.xml#CC01.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
